notes.title: The demo is now live!
notes.content:
The demo of [i]Beyond The Veil[/i] is now available on Steam! 

Play through two chapters in the early stages of the game. Experience the French Quarter of New Orleans, meet a new and interesting character, and make choices that alter both the progression of the story and the personality of Kara, the protagonist!

Featuring stunning art, evocative writing, sound that transports you to New Orleans and voice acting by the wonderful Erika Ishii, download the demo for [i]Beyond The Veil[/i] and add the game to your wishlist today! 

Be sure to tell your friends, and share your thoughts and impressions with us on Twitter @SunShadowGames

notes.title: Beyond The Veil at Melbourne International Games Week!
notes.content: A hour of behind the scenes fun! Becca Scott interviews writer/director Brian Holland, Jess McDonell plays our demo, as well as behind the scenes looks at music, art, and V.O.!

notes.title: Beyond The Veil casts Voice Actor Erika Ishii (Dream Daddy)
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that we have cast [url=https://www.imdb.com/name/nm5604876/]Erika Ishii[/url] as the protagonist Kara in Beyond The Veil!

You may have heard Erika in titles like Dream Daddy, Bleach, Fire Emblem Heroes, or seen her as Annabelle in Geek & Sundry's Vampire: The Masquerade Chronicle, L.A. By Night.

You'll be able to hear Erika as Kara in our upcoming trailer. For all updates, be sure to follow us on twitter @SunShadowGames, and hit that wishlist button if you haven't already!
